completion.about: Vectors for the completion hold of docs/cross-app-semantics-v1.md section 7. Times are milliseconds from the start of the sequence. Events: complete, hoverStart, hoverEnd, focusIn, focusOut (a row id in "row", or "target": "toast"), navigate, and undo ("via": "row" with a row id, or "via": "toast"). Each expect entry is the state after every event up to and including that time, with timers due at that time already fired (a timer fires before an event at the same instant). held and collapsed are row ids in ascending order.

a timer ends before an event at the same instant
